tasks.title: ISTEDA Cap & Wristband
tasks.text: Take a photo of yourself wearing both the exclusive ISTEDA cap and wristband.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Team Selfie
tasks.text: Take a group selfie with at least five ISTEDA team members.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Member Selfie
tasks.text: Take a selfie with an ISTEDA member of the opposite gender.

tasks.title: ISTEDA Face Challenge
tasks.text: Get one of these expressions on camera: Vyshu crying, Maha laughing, Dona blushing, or Lino looking angry. Choose any one.

tasks.title: Meet the New Members
tasks.text: Take a selfie with three ISTEDA members who joined on or after the OKP event.

tasks.title: Dubai Run Throwback
tasks.text: Find someone wearing an older Dubai Run shirt. Take a photo together showing both editions. Bonus bragging rights if you get three different years in one shot.

tasks.title: Shoe Twin
tasks.text: Find a runner wearing shoes of the same brand and colour as yours. Take a photo showing both pairs.

tasks.title: The Runner Rectangle
tasks.text: Find four Dubai Run participants from outside ISTEDA. Make a rectangle with your arms together and ask a friend to take the photo.

tasks.title: Match the Reference Photo
tasks.text: Choose either reference spot: the Al Boursa St 200 m sign or Texas Chicken. Take a photo from the same spot and match the angle as closely as you can.

tasks.title: Direction Challenge ↪️📸
tasks.text: Find a road sign with a left-turn or right-turn arrow. Strike a dramatic pose pointing or leaning in the same direction. Ask a friend to capture you and the sign in the same photo.

tasks.title: Reverse Bibs
tasks.text: Find a runner whose bib ends with your last two digits reversed. If yours ends in 27, look for 72. Take a selfie showing both bibs.

tasks.title: Sheikh Zayed Road Jump 📸
tasks.text: On a clear stretch of the closed Dubai Run route, find two white dashed lane markings in the same row. Jump from one dash toward the next and ask a friend to catch you with both feet off the ground.

tasks.title: Triple 7
tasks.text: Find someone whose bib contains three 7s anywhere in the number. Take a selfie with them holding up seven fingers.

tasks.title: Birthday Challenge
tasks.text: Find someone whose bib ends in the day of the month you were born. If you were born on the 21st, look for 21. Take a selfie while they point to the matching digits.

tasks.title: Maths Match
tasks.text: Find a runner whose last bib digit adds to 10 with yours: 6 + 4, 9 + 1, or 2 + 8. Take a selfie with both bibs visible and show the numbers with your fingers. If your bib ends in 0, find two runners whose bibs end in 9 and 1, and show all three bibs in one photo.

tasks.title: Best Photography Award · 4 points
tasks.text: Submit any photo related to Dubai Run. The winning photo earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Best Selfie · 4 points
tasks.text: Take a selfie with something related to Dubai Run. The winning selfie earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Most Calories Burned
tasks.text: Upload a screenshot or other proof showing your total calories burned on Dubai Run day.
